Bacterial Leaf Blight.organic_treatment: Use copper-based organic bactericides, remove infected leaves, avoid overhead irrigation, practice crop rotation.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.chemical_treatment: Apply streptomycin sulfate or copper oxychloride as per agricultural guidelines.

Bacterial Leaf Streak.organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants, use disease-free seeds, maintain field sanitation.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.chemical_treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides; streptomycin where recommended by local extension officers.

Bacterial Panicle Blight.organic_treatment: Use certified disease-free seeds, avoid excessive nitrogen, improve drainage.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with recommended bactericides; field sprays at panicle initiation if outbreak occurs.

Black Stem Borer.cause: Insect pest (Scirpophaga incertulas) — stem borer larvae damage stems
Black Stem Borer.organic_treatment: Release egg parasitoids (Trichogramma), use light traps, remove stubble after harvest.
Black Stem Borer.chemical_treatment: Apply cartap hydrochloride or fipronil granules at recommended growth stages.

Blast.organic_treatment: Neem oil spray (2-3%), remove infected leaves, maintain proper spacing and balanced fertilization.
Blast.chemical_treatment: Apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane fungicides as per recommended dosage.

Brown Spot.organic_treatment: Apply compost tea or garlic extract spray, ensure proper fertilization and soil health.
Brown Spot.chemical_treatment: Use mancozeb or propiconazole fungicides at recommended intervals.

Downy Mildew.organic_treatment: Improve drainage, avoid waterlogging, use resistant varieties where available.
Downy Mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply metalaxyl or fosetyl-aluminium fungicides during early infection stages.

Hispa.cause: Insect pest (Dicladispa armigera) — beetles scrape leaf tissue
Hispa.organic_treatment: Hand-pick beetles, use neem-based sprays, maintain field hygiene.
Hispa.chemical_treatment: Apply chlorpyrifos or quinalphos as per local agricultural recommendations.

Leaf Roller.cause: Insect pest (Cnaphalocrocis medinalis) — larvae roll and feed on leaves
Leaf Roller.organic_treatment: Use light traps, encourage natural predators, remove rolled leaves with larvae.
Leaf Roller.chemical_treatment: Apply chlorantraniliprole or flubendiamide insecticides at early larval stage.

Tungro.cause: Virus complex transmitted by green leafhoppers (Nephotettix spp.)
Tungro.organic_treatment: Use reflective mulches, remove infected plants, plant resistant varieties.
Tungro.chemical_treatment: Control leafhopper vectors with imidacloprid or thiamethoxam insecticides.

White Stem Borer.cause: Insect pest (Scirpophaga innotata) — stem borer larvae
White Stem Borer.organic_treatment: Remove egg masses by hand, use pheromone traps, destroy crop stubble after harvest.
White Stem Borer.chemical_treatment: Apply carbofuran granules or chlorantraniliprole as per growth-stage guidelines.

Yellow Stem Borer.cause: Insect pest (Scirpophaga incertulas) — dead-heart and white-head symptoms
Yellow Stem Borer.organic_treatment: Clip leaf tips with egg masses, use light traps, release Trichogramma parasitoids.
Yellow Stem Borer.chemical_treatment: Apply cartap hydrochloride or fipronil granules at tillering and flowering stages.

Normal.cause: No disease detected — healthy paddy leaf
Normal.organic_treatment: Continue regular field monitoring and good agricultural practices.
